2014_spells.mental-prison.effectSummary: Deal 5d10 psychic damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.mental-prison.fullDescriptio: Using 1 action, you attempt to bind a creature within an illusory cell that only it perceives. On a successful save, the target takes 5d10 psychic damage, and the spell ends; On a failed save, the target takes 5d10 psychic damage, and you can cause the target to believe it is surrounded by fire, water, or some other danger. On a successful save, the target takes 5d10 psychic damage, and the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
